$comment: Every performance problem planted in slow-app (served by test/helpers/slow-server.js, which adds the API delays, the hero image, the bundle and the vendor origin), with what mantis perf must measure to explain it. test/perf.test.js checks the evidence, and `finding` is what mantis perf --profile mobile must report: the category, the bucket where it is stable, and regexes on the culprit and the fix. Problems without one are covered by the API and third-party findings.

routes./: the orders page, with every problem below
routes./fast: the same app's help page: one request, nothing to fix
routes./dev: the help page as a Vite dev server would serve it

problems.title: The hero image is the LCP element and is lazy-loaded
problems.fix: drop loading="lazy", add fetchpriority="high" (or preload it)

problems.title: The hero is 1200 px wide and drawn about 412 px wide on a phone
problems.fix: srcset/sizes with smaller widths, and a modern format

problems.title: The hero has no width and height, so the page jumps when it arrives
problems.evidence: layout shifts after the image loads

problems.title: A promo banner is inserted above everything once the user is known
problems.fix: reserve its space, or render it with the page

problems.title: A synchronous script in <head> holds the first paint for its 300 ms
problems.fix: defer it, or inline the flags

problems.title: /api/orders waits for /api/user although the server knows the user
problems.fix: start both at once (the server reads the session), or one endpoint

problems.title: /api/orders takes 500 ms on the server
problems.evidence: serverWait >= 450 ms from the unthrottled visit

problems.title: One /api/products request per order
problems.fix: one batched request, or embed the products in /api/orders
problems.evidence: five /api/products/<id> requests from the same line

problems.title: /api/config is fetched twice
problems.fix: fetch once and share the promise

problems.title: renderAllPoints() rescales the chart for every point: quadratic main-thread work
problems.fix: compute the scale once (linear), or move it to a worker
problems.evidence: hotFunctions has renderAllPoints; a long animation frame after the data arrives

problems.title: big.js ships 1500 features and the page calls one
problems.fix: split it and import what the route uses
problems.evidence: coverage: more than 90% of big.js never runs

problems.title: A chat widget from another origin blocks the main thread on start and sends a beacon
problems.fix: load it on interaction or after the page is idle (facade)
problems.evidence: hotFunctions has bootChatWidget on the vendor origin
